facts.business: Bodal Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells dye intermediates, dyestuffs, basic chemicals, and chlor-alkali products, and has entered the benzene derivatives segment through its greenfield facility at Saykha, Gujarat.

capacity_or_capex.item: Greenfield manufacturing facility at Saykha, Gujarat (benzene derivatives: MCB, PNCB, ONCB, MNCB, DCB)
Modernisation and Technology Upgradation with bipolar cells at Unit-XII, Rajpura, Punjab
